title: ADC candidate sues party, INEC over alleged forged withdrawal
description: By Haruna Aliyu, Birnin Kebbi The African Democratic Congress (ADC) candidate for the Zuru/Fakai/Sakaba/Danko-Wasagu Federal Constituency of Kebbi State, Abubakar Sadiq Saadu, has challenged an alleged forged affidavit purportedly withdrawing his candidature ahead of the 2027 general election.
